_comment: Manual overrides for knockout ties whose winner can't be determined from fixtures data alone (penalty shootouts have no recorded score). Key format: '{league_id}_{season}_{round}_{team_id_a}_{team_id_b}' with team_ids sorted numerically ascending. Add entries here as you discover them; bracket.py checks this before giving up on an unresolved tie.

2_2025_Final_42_85.note: PSG beat Arsenal on penalties, 2025-26 UEFA Champions League Final. Added manually 2026-08-24 - api-football fixtures data has no penalty shootout score.
